nina (People Ops): FYI Luca converted contractor->employee 2026-02-15. Payslip shows Italy contractor payment and NL payroll both applied employee social. Need fix. @oliver?

oliver (Payroll): Yep duplicate employee social. Need contractor invoice + remittance + contractor TIN to decide reclaim vs gross-adjust. Reclaim ~6-8w. For speed can do off-cycle net credit and reconcile later.

eva (Finance Ops): We can process off-cycle once docs + JE are in. Send files to finance-payroll@redwood.com. I'll prep JE.

luca (Employee): Uploaded invoice + bank receipt to HR folder (onboard/luca/contractor-payments). Contractor TIN: IT12345678. Re-uploaded here.

oliver (Payroll): Got files. I'll queue off-cycle tagged retro-social-reclaim if approved. Codes: OFFCYCLE_CORR / GL6100. Need manager sign-off + JE.

nina (People Ops): Approved pending docs. Manager pinged. @marta what legal docs needed?

marta (Legal): Need signed contractor declaration confirming INPS paid, invoice + remittance, proof NL start date. We'll draft reclaim support letter and check treaty/A1.

eva (Finance Ops): JE created JE-2026-045 "Off-cycle social contrib correction - Luca". Uploaded to finance drive.

payroll-bot: Payrun 2026-03-offcycle queued job 24567. Awaiting JE + docs. https://payroll.redwood.com/jobs/24567

oliver (Payroll): Scheduling off-cycle once JE + signed declaration present. Will update when processed.

luca (Employee): Thanks — sent signed declaration and reminded manager. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :pray:
